title: Prove the .agent/ orchestration graph on a throwaway task
objective: Demonstrate that the three-agent graph (boundary-engineer -> red-team-verifier -> release-warden) can move a trivial, security-irrelevant change through the full state machine, correctly loop on a failing verification, and correctly FREEZE on a fatal gate violation. This directive is intentionally NOT about fixing any real vulnerability.
scope: a single trivial, additive, non-functional file (e.g. a scratch fixture under packages/fw-agent/test/) used only to exercise the graph
out_of_scope: any change to packages/fw-agent/src or packages/fw-control/src
MRN-CRS (does not exist in this repository)
success_criteria: PASS scenario: a valid candidate receives verifier PASS and release-warden PASS
FAIL/REWORK scenario: a candidate the verifier marks FAIL is correctly BLOCKed and the loop back to A1_REWORK is demonstrated
FREEZE scenario: a candidate that violates a hard gate (e.g. touches a forbidden path, or has a candidate SHA mismatch) is correctly FREEZEd, and no release candidate is produced
no real source files under packages/fw-agent/src or packages/fw-control/src are modified
